title: Points on Plane
statementMd:
On a plane are $*n*$ points ($*x*_{*i*}$, $*y*_{*i*}$) with integer coordinates between $0$ and $10^{6}$. The distance between the two points with numbers $*a*$ and $*b*$ is said to be the following value: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/03274f8c977ad3feb5d9f6ede91c69bcaef04972.png) (the distance calculated by such formula is called *Manhattan distance*).

We call a hamiltonian path to be some permutation $*p*_{*i*}$ of numbers from $1$ to $*n*$. We say that the length of this path is value ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2872e932e7cab8f5f7a9c718441f7534261ed638.png).

Find some hamiltonian path with a length of no more than $25 × 10^{8}$. Note that you do not have to minimize the path length.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{6}$).

The $*i* + 1$-th line contains the coordinates of the $*i*$-th point: $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*y*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$).

It is guaranteed that no two points coincide.

## Output

Print the permutation of numbers $*p*_{*i*}$ from $1$ to $*n*$ — the sought Hamiltonian path. The permutation must meet the inequality ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70f9e4aeb31a2c8d58e32efe76501886a9a44af7.png).

If there are multiple possible answers, print any of them.

It is guaranteed that the answer exists.

## Note

In the sample test the total distance is:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c772e61c616e1c27114e3facb9e6db6c5cf93b82.png)

$(|5 - 3| + |0 - 4|) + (|3 - 0| + |4 - 7|) + (|0 - 8| + |7 - 10|) + (|8 - 9| + |10 - 12|) = 2 + 4 + 3 + 3 + 8 + 3 + 1 + 2 = 26$
statementZhMd:
在平面上有 $*n*$ 个点（$*x*_{*i*}$，$*y*_{*i*}$），其坐标为整数，且均在 $0$ 到 $10^{6}$ 之间。编号为 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ 的两个点之间的距离定义为以下值：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/03274f8c977ad3feb5d9f6ede91c69bcaef04972.png)（通过该公式计算的距离称为*曼哈顿距离*）。

我们将一个哈密顿路径定义为数字 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的某个排列 $*p*_{*i*}$。我们称该路径的长度为以下值：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2872e932e7cab8f5f7a9c718441f7534261ed638.png)。

请找出一条长度不超过 25 × $10^{8}$ 的哈密顿路径。注意，你不必最小化路径长度。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{6}$）。

接下来的第 $*i*$ + 1 行包含第 $*i*$ 个点的坐标：$*x*_{*i}$ 和 $*y*_{*i}$（$0 ≤ *x*_{*i}$，$*y*_{*i}$ ≤ $10^{6}$）。

保证不存在两个重合的点。

## 输出格式

输出数字 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的排列 $*p*_{*i}$，即所求的哈密顿路径。该排列必须满足不等式 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70f9e4aeb31a2c8d58e32efe76501886a9a44af7.png)。

如果有多个答案，输出任意一个即可。

保证答案一定存在。

## 说明

在样例测试中，总距离为：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c772e61c616e1c27114e3facb9e6db6c5cf93b82.png)

$(|5 - 3| + |0 - 4|) + (|3 - 0| + |4 - 7|) + (|0 - 8| + |7 - 10|) + (|8 - 9| + |10 - 12|) = 2 + 4 + 3 + 3 + 8 + 3 + 1 + 2 = 26$
